senses.gloss: (b. h. סָגַד)to bend, bow; to worship.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 27:7">Targ. O. ib. XXVII, 7</cite>; a. fr.—Part. <cite ref="O00129"><he>סָגֵיד</he></cite>, pl. <he>סְגִידִין</he>. Targ. II Esth. III, 2; a. e.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 38">Gen. R. s. 38</cite>, end <he>ווי ליה … ובעי למִסְגַּד לבר יומיה</he> woe to that man who is sixty years old and wants to bow to an idol made to-day!; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 62:14">Yalk. ib. 62</cite> <he>למִסְגּוֹר להדין דעביד יומא דין</he>.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 62:14">Ib.</cite> <he>נִסְגּוֹד לנורא … נסגוד וכ׳</he> let us worship the fire; said he to him, let us worship the water which extinguishes the fire.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:5">Cant. R. to II, 5</cite> <cite ref="M01845"><he>מִסְגֵּיד</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="Q00474"><he>פְּחִיתָא</he></cite>; a. fr.—
